verses.text: ilaa nabiyyin rasuulin jaa-anaa bihudaa
muzih tadaa bikitaabin jaabihi fahadaa
abqaa tahaayaa bilaa ghishin walaa kadarin
minal khadiimil lazii yanhuuhu multahadaa
li-aalihil ghurri wal as-haabi qaatibatan
minnii salaamun yudiimul amna war raghadaa
yaa sayyidii yaa rasuulal laahi yaa amalii
sallaa halaykal lazii qassal lazii maradaa
yaa muntaqaa yaa imaamal mursaliina mahan
halayka tasliimu man saffaa bikal khaladaa
sallaa halayka bitasliimin bilaa hadadin
man lam yakun qattu mawluudan wa lam yalidaa
sallaa wa sallama baaqin laa shariika lahu
halayka bil aali yaa man zahzahal fanadaa
sallaa wa sallamaa baaqin laa nafaada lahu
halayka bis sahbi yaa man qarrabar rashadaa
ahlul madiinati minnii sarmadan lakumu
abqaa salaamin yutiibul qalba wal jasadaa
laa ziltumud dahra fii sawfin wa tawsihatin
yakfiikumul laahu lil jannaati man hanadaa
fuztum bikawnibni habdil laahi jaarakumu
wa kawnakum hawlahu faltahmadus samadaa
sallaa halayhil lazii yanfil hidaa abadan
ilaa siwaa man nahaahud dahra multahadaa
tasurruhu min hayaatii khidmatun qubilat
minnii bifadlil lazii ahdaa bihi fahadaa
